# Reproducing this site {#sec-reproducing}

Everything in this site is computed from cached public data by R code in the repository at <https://github.com/donboyd5/albany_sales_tax>. Nothing is typed in by hand except two lookup tables in `data/crosswalk/`, each row of which cites its source.

## Steps

1. Clone the repository and restore the R environment with `renv::restore()`.
2. Obtain a free Census API key at <https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html> and put it in `.Renviron` as `CENSUS_API_KEY=...`. The key is read from the environment and never written anywhere.
3. Run the data pulls, which are skipped if the cached files in `data/raw/` are present:

```bash
make pulls
```

4. Compute every result the site reports and save them to `data/processed/results.rds`:

```bash
make results
```

5. Render the site:

```bash
make render
```

## How the code is organized

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `R/00_setup.R` | Libraries, paths, key guard, caching and download helpers |
| `R/01_pull_dtf.R` | Tax Department taxable sales and distributions (server-side summarized) |
| `R/02_pull_census_ec.R` | 2022 Economic Census for economic places and counties, with suppression flags |
| `R/03_pull_acs_lodes_dmv.R` | Population, American Community Survey, job-location data, DMV registrations, block and ZIP files |
| `R/04_allocate.R` | Sourcing classes, sharing rules, the division of a county base for any city, customer-type tags |
| `R/05_calibrate.R` | Recovering the seventeen cities' bases; calibration fits and diagnostics |
| `R/06_results.R` | Computes every number on the site into one results file |
| `R/99_check_urls.R` | Checks that every cited URL still resolves |
| `chapters/`, `appendices/` | The site's text; each chapter reads the results file |
| `docs/data-layouts.md` | Verified column lists and surprises for every dataset |
| `docs/meta_notes.md` | Notes for a reviewer: process history, dead ends, what to check |

Every raw pull is recorded in `data/raw/MANIFEST.csv` with its source URL, the time it was pulled and a SHA-256 fingerprint.
